title: ConsentGranted
description: A subject granted consent for a purpose. Evidential rather than operational: a consent record has to outlive a seven-day window to be evidence of anything.

subject_ref.description: Pairwise pseudonym of the data subject. Subject granting consent.

consent_id.description: Consent identifier, stable across grant and withdrawal.

purpose_code.description: Registered purpose code the action was bound to.

items.description: Domain in scope. Only domains that carry pseudonyms can appear: traffic and telemetry are anonymous and vision uses track_ref. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

expires_at.description: When consent lapses if not renewed.

evidence.description: Record of how consent was captured, sealed under the subject's data key so that erasure reaches it.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
